title: Evaluating chain-of-thought monitorability
summary: OpenAI introduces a new framework and evaluation suite for chain-of-thought monitorability, covering 13 evaluations across 24 environments. Our findings show that monitoring a model’s internal reasoning is far more effective than monitoring outputs alone, offering a promising path toward scalable control as AI systems grow more capable.
body: OpenAI introduces a new framework and evaluation suite for chain-of-thought monitorability, covering 13 evaluations across 24 environments. Our findings show that monitoring a model’s internal reasoning is far more effective than monitoring outputs alone, offering a promising path toward scalable control as AI systems grow more capable.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了一套全新的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）可监控性评估框架，涵盖了24个环境下的13项评估指标。研究表明，直接监控模型的内部推理过程比仅监控最终输出结果更为有效。该框架旨在为日益强大的AI系统提供可扩展的控制路径，通过量化推理过程的透明度，帮助开发者更好地理解和引导模型的决策逻辑，是迈向更安全、可控AI的重要技术尝试。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该评估框架为监控大模型内部推理过程提供了量化标准，对提升AI系统的可控性具有重要意义。

glossary.explanationZh: 思维链，指模型在得出最终答案前生成的中间推理步骤。
可监控性，指对模型内部推理过程进行观测和评估的能力。
可扩展控制，指随着模型能力增强，仍能保持对其行为有效监管的方法。
评估套件，用于衡量模型在特定任务或指标上表现的工具集合。
